key: "Elizabeth Connal"
en: "Elizabeth Connal"
ja: 「エリザベス・コナル」

key: "Monty Belrose"
en: "Monty Belrose"
ja: 「モンティ・ベルローズ」

key: "Caroline Belrose"
en: "Caroline Belrose"
ja: 「キャロライン・ベルローズ」

key: "Zina Vanhanen"
en: "Zina Vanhanen"
ja: 「ジーナ・ヴァンハネン」

key: "Kiki Mikael Argall"
en: "Kiki Mikael Argall"
ja: 「キキ・ミカエル・アーガル」

key: "Tara--"
en: "Tara--"

key: SIMON: We meet again, \PN.
en: SIMON: We meet again, \PN.
ja: サイモン: また会ったな、\PN。

key: Why have you come to a place like this? I'm sure you're not here to mourn.
en: Why have you come to a place like this? I'm sure you're not here to mourn.
ja: こんな場所に、何しに来た? 弔いに来たわけじゃないだろう。

key: But I am.
en: But I am.
ja: だが、俺は違う。

key: I've spent far too many hours here already.
en: I've spent far too many hours here already.
ja: もう、あまりにも長い時間をここで過ごしてきた。

key: And now I've lost again.
en: And now I've lost again.
ja: そして今、また失ったんだ。

key: Look.
en: Look.
ja: 見てくれ。

key: SIMON: Not that I could get her body out of the lake, but I figured she at least deserved a memory.
en: SIMON: Not that I could get her body out of the lake, but I figured she at least deserved a memory.
ja: サイモン: 湖から遺体を引き上げることはできなかったが、せめて思い出くらいは残してやりたいと思ってな。

key: I couldn't even find out her last name.
en: I couldn't even find out her last name.
ja: 姓すら、突き止められなかった。

key: I don't know if she had any family, or friends...
en: I don't know if she had any family, or friends...
ja: 家族がいたのか、友人がいたのかすら、わからない……

key: All of that rests at the bottom of the lake now.
en: All of that rests at the bottom of the lake now.
ja: それらすべてが、今は湖の底に沈んでいる。

key: SIMON: I swore that I would get revenge on that woman.
en: SIMON: I swore that I would get revenge on that woman.
ja: サイモン: あの女に仕返しをすると誓った。

key: But what good is another death?
en: But what good is another death?
ja: だが、もう一つ死を重ねたところで、何になる?

key: Someone, somewhere, must feel the same about that woman as I did for Tara... and Lyssa.
en: Someone, somewhere, must feel the same about that woman as I did for Tara... and Lyssa.
ja: どこかで誰かが、あの女に対して、俺がタラに――そしてリッサに抱いたのと同じ思いを抱いているはずだ。

key: Twice now.
en: Twice now.
ja: 二度目だ。

key: Twice, I lost the girl I loved.
en: Twice, I lost the girl I loved.
ja: 二度、愛した女を失った。

key: When my wife died, I could think of nothing else but getting her back.
en: When my wife died, I could think of nothing else but getting her back.
ja: 妻が死んだとき、彼女を取り戻すことしか考えられなかった。

key: Then Commander Sirius came.
en: Then Commander Sirius came.
ja: そこへ、シリウス司令官が現れた。

key: He told me, when Team Meteor recreated the world anew, that I could have my wife back.
en: He told me, when Team Meteor recreated the world anew, that I could have my wife back.
ja: メテオ団が世界を作り直したとき、妻を取り戻せると言われた。

key: I was all too happy to accept.
en: I was all too happy to accept.
ja: 喜んで受け入れたよ。

key: But then I was partnered with Tara, and she was always so energetic and sincere and...
en: But then I was partnered with Tara, and she was always so energetic and sincere and...
ja: だが、タラと組むことになって、彼女はいつも元気で、誠実で……

key: I fell in love with her instead.
en: I fell in love with her instead.
ja: 代わりに、彼女に恋してしまった。

key: She was the light of my world.
en: She was the light of my world.
ja: 彼女は、俺の世界の光だった。

key: Now I'm left with darkness again.
en: Now I'm left with darkness again.
ja: そして今、また闇の中に取り残されている。

key: Do you think, if the world was reborn, I would see them both again?
en: Do you think, if the world was reborn, I would see them both again?
ja: 世界が生まれ変わったら、二人にまた会えると思うか?

key: SIMON: You're probably right.
en: SIMON: You're probably right.
ja: サイモン: お前の言う通りなんだろうな。

key: But then what? How could I explain that to Lyssa?
en: But then what? How could I explain that to Lyssa?
ja: だが、それでどうなる? リッサに、一体どう説明すればいい?

key: Even in redemption, all that awaits me is guilt.
en: Even in redemption, all that awaits me is guilt.
ja: たとえ救われたとしても、待っているのは罪悪感だけだ。

key: SIMON: ...Of course not.
en: SIMON: ...Of course not.
ja: サイモン: ……もちろん、違うな。

key: It was all just a pipe dream to begin with, wasn't it?
en: It was all just a pipe dream to begin with, wasn't it?
ja: そもそも、ただの夢物語にすぎなかったんだ。

key: Running away from this world was just a way to escape my guilt.
en: Running away from this world was just a way to escape my guilt.
ja: この世界から逃げることは、俺の罪悪感からの逃避にすぎなかった。

key: Guilt for losing my wife...
en: Guilt for losing my wife...
ja: 妻を失った罪悪感……

key: Guilt from not dying in Tara's place...
en: Guilt from not dying in Tara's place...
ja: タラの代わりに死ねなかった罪悪感……

key: Guilt for having felt anything for Tara after I swore my life to Lyssa...
en: Guilt for having felt anything for Tara after I swore my life to Lyssa...
ja: リッサに命を誓ったあとに、タラに心を寄せてしまった罪悪感……

key: Even if I saw them again, I couldn't bear to face them.
en: Even if I saw them again, I couldn't bear to face them.
ja: たとえ再び会えたとしても、二人に顔向けなどできない。

key: I'm resigning from Team Meteor.
en: I'm resigning from Team Meteor.
ja: メテオ団を辞める。

key: I've spent too long dwelling on the past already.
en: I've spent too long dwelling on the past already.
ja: 過去にとらわれすぎていた。

key: I can't take it anymore.
en: I can't take it anymore.
ja: もう、これ以上は耐えられない。

key: There's no point in trying to recreate what's already lost.
en: There's no point in trying to recreate what's already lost.
ja: すでに失ったものを、作り直そうとすることに意味はない。

key: If you ever need to find me, I'll be at my home in the west Peridot Ward.
en: If you ever need to find me, I'll be at my home in the west Peridot Ward.
ja: 俺に用があるなら、ペリドットワード西側の家にいる。

key: "Lyssa Copperman"
en: "Lyssa Copperman"
ja: 「リッサ・コッパーマン」

key: VICTORIA: Oh, \PN. I wasn't expecting anyone else...
en: VICTORIA: Oh, \PN. I wasn't expecting anyone else...
ja: ヴィクトリア: あら、\PN。他に誰か来るとは思っていなかったわ……

key: Did you come by to pay your respects as well?
en: Did you come by to pay your respects as well?
ja: あなたも、お参りに来てくれたの?

key: VICTORIA: It took long enough to get everything sorted,
en: VICTORIA: It took long enough to get everything sorted,
ja: ヴィクトリア: すべてを片づけるのに、ずいぶん時間がかかったの、

key: And no small amount of paperwork and legal nonsense.
en: And no small amount of paperwork and legal nonsense.
ja: 山ほどの書類仕事と、くだらない法律上の手続きにね。

key: I understand that they were put in place for a reason but all the laws and procedures just fill the world with mud.
en: I understand that they were put in place for a reason but all the laws and procedures just fill the world with mud.
ja: 理由があって定められたものだとはわかっているけれど、法律や手続きって、世界を泥で埋め尽くすだけのものよね。

key: Where in the world is the average person supposed to find the will to navigate all of that while their heart is still breaking?
en: Where in the world is the average person supposed to find the will to navigate all of that while their heart is still breaking?
ja: 心が傷ついたままの普通の人が、一体どこからそれを乗り越える気力を見つけろって言うのかしら?

key: Is this the mental concentration exercise of the adult world?
en: Is this the mental concentration exercise of the adult world?
ja: これが、大人の世界の精神統一の修行なのかしら?

key: Clear your mind and focus on nothing,
en: Clear your mind and focus on nothing,
ja: 心を空にして、何にも意識を向けず、

key: Except the steady rhythmic tap-tap of the pen checking off boxes on the third triplicate page.
en: Except the steady rhythmic tap-tap of the pen checking off boxes on the third triplicate page.
ja: ただ、三枚複写の三枚目にチェックを入れるペンの、規則正しいトントンという音だけに集中する。

key: It's therapeutic, we promise.
en: It's therapeutic, we promise.
ja: きっと、心が休まるはずよ。

key: I don't know how anyone is supposed to deal with all of that under normal circumstances,
en: I don't know how anyone is supposed to deal with all of that under normal circumstances,
ja: 普段でさえ、一体どうやってあれに対処すればいいのかわからないのに、

key: Let alone when grieving.
en: Let alone when grieving.
ja: 悲しみの中でなんて、なおさらだわ。

key: What if it were my own mother?
en: What if it were my own mother?
ja: もしこれが、わたし自身の母のことだったら?

key: Kiki isn't technically my family.
en: Kiki isn't technically my family.
ja: キキは、厳密にはわたしの家族じゃない。

key: My dad and I are on decent terms, but I haven't talked to my mom in ages.
en: My dad and I are on decent terms, but I haven't talked to my mom in ages.
ja: 父とはまあまあうまくやってるけど、母とはもうずっと話していないの。

key: Kiki was more of a mother to me than my own.
en: Kiki was more of a mother to me than my own.
ja: キキは、実の母よりもずっと、わたしにとって母のような人だった。

key: And she didn't have a daughter.
en: And she didn't have a daughter.
ja: それに、彼女には娘がいなかった。

key: She had made her will months ago, and left everything--
en: She had made her will months ago, and left everything--
ja: 数か月前に遺言を残していて、すべてを――

key: Every single thing--
en: Every single thing--
ja: 何もかもを――

key: To me.
en: To me.
ja: わたしに遺してくれたの。

key: I thought, surely she had cousins--
en: I thought, surely she had cousins--
ja: てっきり、いとこか誰かがいるんだと思ってた――

key: A sibling--
en: A sibling--
ja: きょうだいとか――

key: Something...
en: Something...
ja: 誰か……

key: But I guess not.
en: But I guess not.
ja: でも、いなかったみたい。

key: I never asked about her family.
en: I never asked about her family.
ja: 家族のことなんて、一度も聞かなかった。

key: I never asked if she talked to anyone outside, if she left someone behind--
en: I never asked if she talked to anyone outside, if she left someone behind--
ja: 誰か外に話す相手がいるのか、誰かを残してきたのかも、聞いたことがなかった――

key: I thought it wasn't my business.
en: I thought it wasn't my business.
ja: わたしには関係のないことだと思ってた。

key: How lonely must she have been?
en: How lonely must she have been?
ja: 彼女は、どれだけ孤独だったんだろう?

key: How lonely did I let her be just because I thought I was further away from her--
en: How lonely did I let her be just because I thought I was further away from her--
ja: 自分は彼女とは距離があるんだと思い込んで、どれだけ彼女を孤独にさせてしまったんだろう――

key: No, I--
en: No, I--
ja: ううん、わたし――

key: Without ever meaning to, I pushed her away.
en: Without ever meaning to, I pushed her away.
ja: そんなつもりはなかったのに、彼女を遠ざけてしまっていたの。

key: Professional boundaries and respect, sure...
en: Professional boundaries and respect, sure...
ja: 職業上の一線とか、礼儀とか、そういうものはあったけど……

key: But what good are those now?!
en: But what good are those now?!
ja: 今となっては、それが何になるって言うの?!

key: More than just student and teacher,
en: More than just student and teacher,
ja: ただの師弟という以上に、

key: We could have been family--
en: We could have been family--
ja: わたしたち、家族になれたかもしれないのに――

key: We could have been...
en: We could have been...
ja: なれたかもしれないのに……

key: "Officer Jacob S. Crowley -Passed in recent service"
en: "Officer Jacob S. Crowley -Passed in recent service"
ja: 「ジェイコブ・S・クロウリー巡査――殉職」

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
